dedupe_keys.name: a comprehensive dataset for word wheel water meter reading under challenging conditions

description: A Comprehensive Dataset for Word-Wheel Water Meter Reading Under Challenging Conditions is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Shunyi Zhao et al. We present a dataset designed for segmentation, recognition, and classification tasks related to word-wheel type water meter reading. This dataset encompasses a wide range of real-world scenarios, including clear, blurry, reflective, and obstructed images, captured under various environmental conditions. As a result, it provides a benchmark for model training and evaluating. Coverage: global; published in 2026. Formats: CSV, Image. The data are held in Dryad and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2615007917 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
